conbody.p: Home is the project at a glance, and where OpenV opens when you sign in: on the project you opened last. Along the top are its figures: how many artifacts it holds, the share of requirements that are traced (a test case verifies them) and verified, and how many fail their tests. Beside the project's name are its last baseline and the number of members.
Needs you lists what waits on the team, each with a link to deal with it:

ul.li: suspect: a link whose ends changed after it was made; confirm it or remove it on the Review Queue page.
test run: a run still in progress, with how many test cases are left.
failing: a test case whose last result is a fail, and the requirements it verifies.
comment: a recent comment on an artifact.

conbody.p: The Audit trail shows the newest events of the project, who did what to which artifact; Full history opens the Activity page. Projects lists your workspace's projects with how far each is traced and verified, and when agents have proposed changes, a card counts the proposals waiting and opens the agent runs to review them.
On a phone, Home shows the figures as four tiles, then Needs you, the proposals and the recent activity.
